summary: Frontend-only retest for SUNSU Expo app on mobile viewport 390x844. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. Primary bug is fixed: after OTP verify, user is navigated OFF the auth screen (router.replace('/(tabs)') or the redirect param). Coupons GET /api/coupons is now public and returns WELCOME10/FIRST50/SUNSU20 to guests. Cart empty-state message renders on two lines with no literal backslash-n. Cart -> checkout gate correctly redirects to /auth?redirect=%2Fcheckout and lands on /checkout after verify (checkout-next visible).

issues: Duplicate testID='home-search' rendered twice in DOM causing Playwright strict-mode violations (screen renders correctly on device though). Consider adding a stable single wrapper testID.

action_items: None blocking — bug fixes verified. Optional: dedupe the duplicate testID='home-search' element on home screen (renders twice).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx onVerify correctly uses router.replace(params.redirect || '/(tabs)') — fixes the stuck-on-login bug on device.
coupons.tsx uses useFetch('/coupons', false) with auth-required=false, matching the now-public GET /api/coupons endpoint in commerce.py.
cart.tsx empty state title uses a real newline character ('\n' JS escape) resulting in a two-line render; no literal backslash-n leaks to UI.
cart.tsx onCheckout correctly passes redirect='/checkout' to /auth so post-verify router.replace lands directly on /checkout.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded coupons and existing product 'mango-energy-mix'. Test phone 9876543210 with dynamically returned dev_otp.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OTP auth uses testID dev-otp-hint containing 'Dev OTP: XXXXXX'. Parse with regex (\d{6}). Onboarding shows on first load — click 'Skip' (get_by_text). Bottom tabs are Home/Shop/Categories/Cart/Account without tab-* testIDs; use get_by_text('Cart'/'Account'/'Shop', exact=True).first. Use .first for locators to avoid strict-mode duplicate errors (home-search is rendered twice). Cart -> checkout deep-link works via /auth?redirect=%2Fcheckout.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: auth verify called router.back() which is unreliable on physical device/modal presentation, so user remained on the login screen. Fix (verified): use router.replace(params.redirect || '/(tabs)'). Verified live that after OTP verify the user is navigated away from auth (otp-input no longer in DOM) and lands on tabs root or the redirect path (/checkout when coming from cart checkout gate).
